title: IoT Fleet Management
register_button_on_login_site: Don't have an account yet? Register here
password_requirements_header: Password must meet the following requirements:
login_button_on_register_site: Already have an account? Log in
profile_ui_name: Change your profile name - this does not change the username, which is used for the log in.
help_description: Contact support or find answers in the Frequently Asked Questions.
help_popup_faq_how_register: How can I register my device?
help_popup_faq_how_register_info: Clicking on the big plus opens a menu in which you are asked to enter a key. This is the key that should be found somewhere on the back or bottom of your device, enter the correct key and your device should appear in the dashboard.
help_popup_faq_how_remove: How can I remove a device?
help_popup_faq_how_remove_info: The detail view contains a button 'Remove', which opens a message asking you to confirm removing the device from your dashboard. See 'How can I open the detail view?' for further information.
help_popup_faq_status_red: Why is the status of all my devices red when I log in?
help_popup_faq_status_red_info: Upon log in the status of all your registered devices is checked, this can take up to 90 seconds, until then they continue to be displayed as offline.
help_popup_faq_cant_see: Why can't I see my device?
help_popup_faq_cant_see_info: Once a device is registered, it should appear in your dashboard. See 'How can I register my device?' for further information on how to add a device to your dashboard. Should the device still not show, please don't hesitate to contact the support.
help_popup_faq_how_update: How can I update my device?
help_popup_faq_how_update_info: If an update is available, a button 'Update' appears. Clicking this button opens a popup menu, where you can choose to update the device now, schedule the update for another time, or cancel.
help_popup_faq_what_schedule: What happens when I 'schedule' an update?
help_popup_faq_what_schedule_info: Scheduling an update means selecting a time at which the device will automatically be updated.
help_popup_faq_change_username: How can I change my username?
help_popup_faq_change_username_info: In the upper right-hand corner of the dashboard should be a profile button, which opens a popup menu when clicked. There you can edit your username.
help_popup_faq_open_detail_view: How can I open the detail view?
help_popup_faq_open_detail_view_info: In the upper right-hand corner of your device list should be a small icon: a circled in i. Clicking it opens the detail view.
